points.text: 1 myelinated has faster speed (of transmission of action potential) ;
2 (myelinated) $Na^{+}$ channels only occur at nodes of Ranvier or (non-myelinated) $Na^{+}$ channels occur along length of neurone ;
3 (myelinated) depolarisation only occurs at nodes or (non-myelinated) depolarisation occurs along length of neurone ;
4 (myelinated) long local circuits or (non-myelinated) short local circuits ;
